title: Housewife
summary: HOUSEWIFE, noun hous'wife. [house and wife; contracted into huswife, hussy.] The mistress of a family. 1. A female economist; a good manager. 2. One skilled in female business. 3. A little case or bag

inlines.v: HOUSEWIFE, noun hous'wife. [house and wife; contracted into huswife, hussy.] The mistress of a family. 1. A female economist; a good manager. 2. One skilled in female business. 3. A little case or bag for articles of female work.
